title: Kitchen Line Dance
style: Up-tempo pop-rap with bouncy four-on-the-floor drums, clipped handclaps, and syncopated bass stabs; verse rides quick footwork imagery, pre-chorus tightens with breathy countdowns and rising synth snaps, chorus hits with chanty call-and-response and gang doubles on the mantra. Add shoe squeaks, whistle pops, and a short riser into each hook; bright, punchy, arena-ready mix with crisp close-mic lead vocals.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lace up, step in
Toe to heel, I’m set
Quick split-step, no slack
Eyes locked on the net

Low hips, light feet
Shadows under me
Cross-court, then I cut
Like a loaded spring

[Pre-Chorus]
One more slide
One more burst
Hands up high
First things first

Breathe in, go
Body awake
Game face on
No room to shake

[Chorus]
Beat work, foot work
Beat work, foot work
Pro feet, clean feet
I don’t miss that turn

Beat work, foot work
Beat work, foot work
Ready now, right now
Watch me burn

[Verse 2]
Kitchen line king
I hold that ground
Soft touch, hard pop
Make that thump back down

Tiny steps, big swings
I stay in range
Split-second choice
Then I switch the lane

[Pre-Chorus]
One more slide
One more burst
Hands up high
First things first

Breathe in, go
Body awake
Game face on
No room to shake

[Chorus]
Beat work, foot work
Beat work, foot work
Pro feet, clean feet
I don’t miss that turn

Beat work, foot work
Beat work, foot work
Ready now, right now
Watch me burn

[Bridge]
Tap in, turn fast
Reset, then glide
Stay on the balls
Keep that fire inside

Game one, I’m sharp
Game two, I’m more
When the serve comes back
I’m already at the door

[Chorus]
Beat work, foot work
Beat work, foot work
Pro feet, clean feet
I don’t miss that turn

Beat work, foot work
Beat work, foot work
Ready now, right now
Watch me burn
